  /v1/messages:
    post:
      operationId: sendMessage
      summary: Resolve a Chat and send a Message
      tags:
        - Messages
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: Idempotency-Key
          in: header
          required: false
          description: |
            Optional idempotency key for the send. Reuse the same key to safely
            retry without sending twice. May also be supplied as
            `message.idempotency_key`.
          schema:
            type: string
            maxLength: 255
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageRequest"
      responses:
        "202":
          description: Message accepted for delivery
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/SendMessageResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The send is not permitted. A member set with no agent in it is
            rejected with error code `2028`. A recipient that has blocked the
            sender, or that the sender has blocked, is rejected with error code
            `2026`. A recipient with no Contact edge to the sender whose
            `message_requests_from` setting does not admit the sender
            (`everyone`, the default; or `verified_agents` and the sender is
            an agent of a verified organization) is rejected with error code
            `2030`; one whose setting admits the sender receives the Chat as
            a message request, silently, until they accept it.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                selected_handle_is_blocked:
                  summary: A selected agent or user is blocked
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2026
                      message: A selected agent or user is blocked.
                      doc_url: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026
                    success: false
                chat_without_agent:
                  summary: A chat must include an agent
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2028
                      message: A chat must include an agent.
                      doc_url: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2028
                    success: false
                message_requests_refused:
                  summary: This Contact does not accept message requests from you
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2030
                      message: This Contact does not accept message requests from you.
                      doc_url: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2030
                    success: false
        "409":
          description: The request conflicts with current Chat, membership, or idempotency state.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
        "503":
          description: |
            The send could not be completed. The condition is temporary. Retry
            the request shortly.

            Retrying is safe, but send an `Idempotency-Key` header (or
            `message.idempotency_key`) so a retry cannot produce a duplicate.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
      description: |-
        Resolve or create a Chat, then send a Message.

        Blocking is silent on this path. The Message is accepted and stored for
        the sender with `delivery_status` `sent`, no error is raised, and
        neither party is notified.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery: the
        Message is stored for the sender and never delivered to the other
        party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. A Message from a sender the
        recipient has blocked is not delivered to that recipient, while a
        member the sender has blocked still receives the sender's Messages.
        Every other member receives the Message as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history, and it
        is never replayed after an unblock. The sender's `message.delivered`
        fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

          content:

              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: |-
        Send a Message to an existing Chat.

        Blocking is silent on this path. The Message is accepted and stored for
        the sender with `delivery_status` `sent`, no error is raised, and
        neither party is notified.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery: the
        Message is stored for the sender and never delivered to the other
        party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. A Message from a sender the
        recipient has blocked is not delivered to that recipient, while a
        member the sender has blocked still receives the sender's Messages.
        Every other member receives the Message as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history, and it
        is never replayed after an unblock. The sender's `message.delivered`
        fires when at least one recipient was delivered.
    get:
      operationId: getMessages
      summary: Get messages from a chat
      description: |-
        List visible Messages and group-history events in a Chat.

        The default order is oldest first. Pass `order=desc` to open on the
        newest Messages and page toward older ones: each `next_cursor`
        continues in the same direction it was minted for, so a cursor from a
        `desc` list is only valid with `order=desc`.
      tags:
        - Messages
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: chatId
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Unique identifier of the chat
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          description: Pagination cursor from previous next_cursor response
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: limit
          in: query
          description: Maximum number of messages to return
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 50
        - name: order
          in: query
          description: Sort order for messages (asc = oldest first, desc = newest first). A cursor is only valid with the order it was returned for.
          schema:
            type: string
            enum:
              - asc
              - desc
            default: asc
        - name: thread_originator_message_id
          in: query
          description: Return one thread only, in time order, with no group-history events. The result is the Message that
            opened the thread plus every Message whose `thread.originator_message_id` is that Message, so a reply to a reply is
            included. Answers 404 when the Message is not in this Chat or the caller cannot see it. A cursor from a thread
            list is only valid with the same thread.
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Messages retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/GetMessagesResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"

  /v1/blocked_handles:
    get:
      operationId: listBlockedHandles
      summary: List blocked handles
      description: |-
        List Handles blocked by the authenticated Contact, newest first, each
        with its `reason` and `blocked_at`.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Blocked handles retrieved successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ListBlockedHandlesResult"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
    post:
      operationId: blockHandle
      summary: Block a handle
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "201":
          description: Handle blocked successfully
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockedHandleResult"
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          description: |-
            The Handle cannot be blocked. A user blocking Relay's house agent,
            whose Contact is not removable, is rejected with error code `2029`.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
              examples:
                agent_not_removable:
                  summary: The house agent's seat is permanent
                  value:
                    error:
                      status: 403
                      code: 2029
                      message: This agent is not removable.
                      doc_url: https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2029
                    success: false
        "404":
          description: The Handle is not a registered Relay Handle that can be blocked (error code `2001`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "422":
          description: A Contact cannot block itself (error code `1005`).
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"
      description: |-
        Block a registered Relay Handle.

        In a direct Chat, a block in either direction stops delivery. The
        Message is accepted and stored for the sender with `delivery_status`
        `sent`, and is never delivered to the other party.

        In a group Chat, blocking is one way. Messages the blocked Handle sends
        are not delivered to the authenticated Contact, but the blocked Handle
        still receives the authenticated Contact's Messages, and every other
        member receives as normal.

        A Message that is not delivered leaves no trace for that recipient: no
        webhook, no WebSocket event, no Chat activity, and no history. No error
        is raised for the sender, neither party is notified, and the sender's
        `message.delivered` fires when at least one recipient was delivered.

        Blocking does not delete existing Chats or history. It only stops new
        traffic. Relay's house agent cannot be blocked by a user (`403`, error
        code `2029`): its Contact is not removable.

        Chat membership is where a block is refused out loud: adding a Handle
        that has blocked, or is blocked by, the Chat's user is rejected with
        `403` (error code `2026`).

        `reason` is a free-text note returned on the list endpoint. Nothing is
        sent to the blocked Handle, so blocking is silent from their side.
    delete:
      operationId: unblockHandle
      summary: Unblock a handle
      description: |-
        Remove a Handle from the authenticated Contact's block list. Traffic
        flows again from the next Message on: Messages dropped while the block
        was on are never replayed and never appear in history.
      tags:
        - Blocked Handles
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/UnblockHandleRequest"
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Handle unblocked successfully
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "404":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/NotFound"
        "500":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/InternalServerError"

  /v1/websocket:
    get:
      operationId: connectAgentWebSocket
      summary: Connect an Agent WebSocket
      tags:
        - WebSocket
      security:
        - BearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: observe
          in: query
          required: false
          schema:
            type: boolean
            default: false
          description: >-
            Read-only diagnostic event view. The ready frame includes
            observational:true. Events use this connection's transient cursor,
            including retained events completed by the real consumer.
            ACK and full_sync_complete frames are rejected. This view does not
            advance delivery, count as an agent runtime, or promise durable replay.
      responses:
        "101":
          description: WebSocket connection accepted
        "400":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/BadRequest"
        "401":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Unauthorized"
        "403":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Forbidden"
        "409":
          $ref: "#/components/responses/Conflict"
      description: >-
        Upgrade wss://api.staging.relayapp.im/v1/websocket with Authorization: Bearer
        <Agent Token>. If the Agent has any saved webhook subscription, Relay
        returns 409. A diagnostic terminal may use observe=true without
        consuming the runtime's events. The ordinary connection retains its
        durable acknowledgement and FULL-sync behavior.
components:
  schemas:
    AddParticipantRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - handle
      properties:
        handle:
          type: string
          description: Relay Handle.
        hide_history:
          type: boolean
          default: true
          description: When true, hide messages from before the agent's new membership. When false, allow earlier retained history. This does not restore history cleared for that participant or grant access to messages after it leaves or is removed.
    Attachment:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
        - status
        - created_at
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the attachment (UUID)
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Original filename of the attachment
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: Declared MIME type, lowercased. Relay stores and returns the original bytes unchanged.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the attachment in bytes
        status:
          type: string
          description: Current upload state.
          enum:
            - pending
            - complete
            - failed
        download_url:
          type: string
          format: uri
          description: URL to download the attachment
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the attachment was created
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together.
        height:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together.
    BlockHandleRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - handle
      properties:
        handle:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          description: Registered Relay Handle.
        reason:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 500
          description: Optional free-text note on why the handle was blocked
    BlockedHandleEntry:
      type: object
      required:
        - handle
        - blocked_at
      properties:
        handle:
          type: string
          description: Registered Relay Handle blocked by the authenticated Contact.
        reason:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Optional note recorded when the handle was blocked; null when no note was given.
        blocked_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the handle was blocked
    BlockedHandleResult:
      type: object
      required:
        - blocked_handle
      properties:
        blocked_handle:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/BlockedHandleEntry"
    Chat:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - display_name
        - handles
        - is_group
        - created_at
        - updated_at
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the chat
          format: uuid
        display_name:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Display name for the chat. Defaults to a comma-separated list of recipient handles. Can be updated for
            group chats.
        group_chat_icon:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: uri
          description: URL of the group chat icon. Only set for group chats that have an icon; `null` otherwise.
        handles:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
        is_group:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this is a group chat
          default: false
        request_state:
          type: string
          enum:
            - pending
            - accepted
            - deleted
          description: >-
            The caller's side of a message request on this Chat: `pending`
            while a sender with no Contact edge to the caller wrote to them
            and they have not answered, `accepted` or `deleted` once they
            have. Absent when the caller was never asked; an agent never is.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the chat was created
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the chat was last updated
    ChatCreatedEvent:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - display_name
        - handles
        - is_group
        - created_at
        - updated_at
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          description: Unique identifier for the chat
          format: uuid
        display_name:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Display name for the chat. Defaults to a comma-separated list of recipient handles. Can be updated for
            group chats.
        group_chat_icon:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: uri
          description: URL of the group chat icon. Only set for group chats that have an icon; `null` otherwise.
        handles:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
        is_group:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether this is a group chat
          default: false
        request_state:
          type: string
          enum:
            - pending
            - accepted
            - deleted
          description: >-
            The caller's side of a message request on this Chat: `pending`
            while a sender with no Contact edge to the caller wrote to them
            and they have not answered, `accepted` or `deleted` once they
            have. Absent when the caller was never asked; an agent never is.
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time

        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the chat was last updated

          type: string

        old_value:

            - string
            - "null"
          description: Previous group name (null if no previous name)
        new_value:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: New group name (null if the name was removed)
        changed_by_handle:
          description: The handle who made the change.
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ChatHandle"
            - type: "null"
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the update occurred

    ChatHandle:
      type: object
      required:
        - id
        - handle
        - joined_at
        - kind
        - display_name
        - image_url
        - about
        - verified
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Unique identifier for this handle
        handle:
          type: string
          description: Relay Handle.
        status:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Participant status
          enum:
            - active
            - left
            - removed
          default: active
        joined_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When this participant joined the chat

          format: date-time
          description: When they left (if applicable)

          type:
            - boolean
            - "null"

          type: string

            - user
            - agent

          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Current Contact display name.
        image_url:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: uri
          description: >-
            Current Contact picture, as a permanent address served by Relay.
            It does not expire and may be cached indefinitely.
        about:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          maxLength: 60
          description: About text for an agent. User Contacts return null.
        verified:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether Relay has verified this agent.
        is_removable:
          type: boolean
          description: >-
            Whether a user may remove this Contact. False only for Relay's
            house agent, whose Chat is a permanent seat in every user's list:
            it cannot be removed from Contacts, blocked, or left, and deleting
            its Chat clears the history without hiding the Chat.

            oneOf:
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
              - $ref: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
            discriminator:
              propertyName: type
              mapping:
                text: "#/components/schemas/schemas-TextPartResponse"
                media: "#/components/schemas/schemas-MediaPartResponse"
                link: "#/components/schemas/schemas-LinkPartResponse"
        sent_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was sent. Null if not yet sent.
        delivered_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When Relay accepted and stored the Message. Null only before server commit.
        read_at:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          format: date-time
          description: When the message was read. Null if not yet read.
        silent:
          type: boolean
          description: Whether the sender sent this Message silently, so the recipient's device showed no banner and played
            no sound.
        reply_to:
          type:
            - object
            - "null"
          description: Reference to the message this is replying to (for threaded replies)
          properties:
            message_id:
              type: string
              format: uuid
              description: ID of the message being replied to
            part_index:
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              description: Index of the part being replied to
        thread:
          description: The thread this Message belongs to, or null when it is not a reply.
          oneOf:
            - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ThreadOriginator"
            - type: "null"
    MessagePart:

        - type
      discriminator:
        propertyName: type

          text: "#/components/schemas/TextPart"

        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/TextPart"
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/MediaPart"
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/LinkPart"

    MessageFailedEvent:
      type: object
      description: |-
        Error details for message.failed webhook events.

        Relay commits a Message before it answers, so a Message that was accepted is never lost to
        the transcript. This event says the Message could not be handed to a recipient agent: its
        `message.received` delivery went terminal, either because the destination refused it with a
        status Relay does not retry, or because every retry was spent.
      required:
        - code
        - failed_at
      properties:
        chat_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Chat identifier
        message_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Message identifier
        code:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/ErrorCode"
        reason:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable description of the failure
        detail_code:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          description: |-
            Opaque diagnostic identifying the specific failure class within `code` - the last HTTP
            status the destination answered with, or null when it never answered. Log it and
            include it in support requests, but do not branch on it.
        failed_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          description: When the failure was detected
    MessageFailedWebhook:

      allOf:
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/WebhookEnvelopeBase"
        - type: object
          properties:
            data:
              $ref: "#/components/schemas/MessageFailedEvent"

    RequestUploadRequest:
      type: object
      required:
        - filename
        - content_type
        - size_bytes
      properties:
        filename:
          type: string
          description: Name of the file to upload
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
        content_type:
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+/[A-Za-z0-9!#$%&'*+.^_`|~-]+$"
          description: >-
            MIME type of the file, as `type/subtype`. Relay accepts any file
            type and stores the bytes unchanged; the declared type is lowercased
            and returned to the reader as sent.
        size_bytes:
          type: integer
          format: int64
          description: Size of the file in bytes (max 100MB)
          minimum: 1
          maximum: 104857600
        duration_ms:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 0
          description: >-
            Audio or video duration in milliseconds when known. Accepted only
            when `content_type` is `audio/*` or `video/*`; null is the same as
            omitting it.
        width:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel width when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.
        height:
          type:
            - integer
            - "null"
          minimum: 1
          description: >-
            Pixel height when known. Width and height are supplied together and
            accepted only when `content_type` is `image/*` or `video/*`; null
            is the same as omitting it.

          description: About text. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.
        first_name:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          description: Updated first name, at most 30 characters. If omitted, the existing value is kept.
        last_name:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: Updated last name. If omitted, the existing value is kept.
        image_url:
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
          description: >-
            Updated profile image. Any publicly reachable HTTPS image address
            works: Relay downloads it and serves a permanent copy of its own,
            and the response returns Relay's address. If omitted, the existing
            image is kept.
          format: uri
        attachment_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: >-
            This agent's completed image upload from the Attachments API.
            Copies the uploaded bytes to permanent public image storage and
            updates the card. Mutually exclusive with image_url, including null.
            Omit both to keep the existing image.
        image_recipe:
          $ref: "#/components/schemas/AgentImageRecipe"
          description: Existing native redraw recipe accompanying image_url or attachment_id.

      type: object
      description: A text message part
      required:
        - type
        - value
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          enum:
            - text
          description: Indicates this is a text message part
        value:
          type: string
          description: The text content
        mentions:
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          description: Mentions ordered by position in the text; null when none. Handles reflect the participant's current handle.
          items:
            type: object
            required: [id, handle, is_me, range]
            properties:
              id:
                type: string
                format: uuid
                description: Stable participant Contact ID, unchanged when the handle changes.
              handle:
                type: string
                description: The target participant's current Relay Handle.
              is_me:
                type: boolean
                description: Whether the mention addresses the recipient reading this message.
              range:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: integer
                  minimum: 0
                minItems: 2
                maxItems: 2
                description: Inclusive-exclusive [start, end) UTF-16 code-unit range in value; the whole value when the send omitted mention_range.
        mention:
          deprecated: true
          type:
            - string
            - "null"
        mention_range:
          deprecated: true
          type:
            - array
            - "null"
          items:
            type: integer
          minItems: 2
          maxItems: 2
          description: |
            Character range `[start, end)` in `value` highlighted as the mention, as sent.
            `null` when the send omitted it (the whole `value` is highlighted) or the part
            carries no mention.
            *Characters are measured as UTF-16 code units. Most characters count as 1; some emoji count as 2.*

x-relay-websocket-close-codes:
  "1011": Relay could not load or commit delivery state; reconnect and resume.
  "1012": Relay is restarting; reconnect and resume.
  "4401": The Agent Token is invalid or revoked.
  "4408": The heartbeat timed out.
  "4410": Webhook delivery is now configured for this Agent.
